description.zh: 邮件地址，长度1-60，支持数字、字母、.、-、@。
description.en: The email address. The length is 1 to 60 characters. It supports digits, letters, periods (.), hyphens (-), and at signs (@).
The current page number. The default value is 1.
The number of entries per page. The default value is 10.

发信地址类型。取值：

- trigger：触发邮件
description.en:
The type of the sender address. Valid values:

- batch: batch emails

- trigger: triggered emails

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dm query-mail-address-by-param --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --key-word Account+@+domain --sendtype batch --api-version 2015-11-23 --region cn-hangzhou
